apps.name: Moonplace
apps.line: A daily logic puzzle: one moon in every row, column and region, and no two touching.

apps.name: Heightlings
apps.line: Measure your kids with the camera and follow their growth on real charts, each one as a cartoon character.

apps.name: Evenplace
apps.line: Fill the board with two kinds of pieces, evenly, never three alike in a line.

apps.name: Quiltplace
apps.line: Cut the grid into rectangles, one number in each, and watch a quilt come together.

apps.name: Isleplace
apps.line: Join the islands with bridges until every island has the number it asks for.

apps.name: Nineplace
apps.line: A calm daily Sudoku whose hints name the technique and show the squares that prove it.
